title.zh: 查询备份数据上云任务列表

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎

- RDS SQL Server

### 功能说明
该接口可以查询实例在最近一周内的备份数据上云任务记录。

### 注意事项
* 备份数据上云的源备份文件必须是全量备份（FULL）文件。
* 暂不支持SQL Server 2017集群版实例。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engine

*   SQL Server

### [](#)Usage notes

This operation allows you to query the migration tasks that are created for the instance over the last week.

### [](#)Precautions

*   This operation is supported only for migration tasks that are created to migrate full backup files.
*   This operation is not supported for instances that run SQL Server 2017 on RDS Cluster Edition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-migrate-tasks --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --start-time 2017-10-20T01:00Z --end-time 2017-10-25T01:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
